REGION.title: US region (0 through 4)
REGION.description: US search region, from 0 through 4. Repeated runs rotate through the whole country.

MAX_PAGES.title: Browser pages per run
MAX_PAGES.description: Zero means no request-count cutoff. The time budget still applies; unfinished work remains queued.

MAX_DISCOVERY_PAGES.title: Discovery pages per run
MAX_DISCOVERY_PAGES.description: Zero means no request-count cutoff. The time budget still applies; unfinished work remains queued.

MAX_DOCUMENTS.title: Posters and packets per run
MAX_DOCUMENTS.description: Zero means no request-count cutoff. The time budget still applies; unfinished work remains queued.

MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS.title: Runtime budget (seconds)
MAX_RUNTIME_SECONDS.description: Soft processing budget. Use a 300-second platform timeout for a five-minute run.

DRY_RUN.title: Test without publishing
DRY_RUN.description: Extract and verify public events without writing anything to the website.

SEED_ONLY.title: Use only diagnostic URLs
SEED_ONLY.description: Skip nationwide discovery and inspect only the diagnostic URLs supplied below.

SEED_URLS.title: Diagnostic URLs, one per line
SEED_URLS.description: Optional public diagnostic URLs, separated by commas or new lines.
